thread:
Jing (Nova): Hi all, launching a 2-week POC next week. Need a sandbox billing org with $2,000 credits, a hard spend shield at $2,000, ephemeral API keys for devs, and a small Dedicated node (A10G) behind a peered VPC. Also want guidance on enforcing model/quantization whitelist for cost control.

Ari H: Welcome, Jing. We can do that. To confirm: sandbox org + credits, hard spend shield, project-scoped ephemeral keys (TTL options), Dedicated request for us-east-1, and model whitelist. Anything else (SLA/retention)?

Jing (Nova): Retention: logs for 120 days for audit. SLA not required for POC. For Dedicated we'd like 1xA10G and a 2-hour boot window ETA. Team will run ~15 rps interactive and occasional 100-concurrency batch jobs.

Felix (SE): Noted. For ephemeral keys we normally issue 24h or 72h TTLs. We can also create a service key bound to the sandbox project if you need long-running CI. Example request we use internally:

```
POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/projects/{proj}/ephemeral-keys
Authorization: Bearer RESELLER_TOKEN
Body: {"ttl_seconds":259200, "purpose":"nova integration"}
```

Priya B: On billing: we can seed $2,000 in credits and enable a hard spend shield. Legal needs the POC spend acknowledgement signed. I'll attach the doc and a short form. Also we offer a soft budget alert at 75% and email + Slack alerts.

InfraBot: Dedicated pool request created: ticket INF-5567. Waiting for VPC details and AWS account ID.

Ari H: For model controls we can attach a policy named cost-sandbox-restrictions that enforces allowed_models:["quant-ggml-*","mini-llama-*"], max_tokens_per_minute=20000, max_generation_tokens=512. We can apply to the project during onboarding.

Jing (Nova): Sounds good. VPC CIDR 10.200.0.0/16, AWS acct 210987654321. Please enable VPC flow logs delivered to our S3 with 120d retention.

Felix (SE): Got it. I'll add the flow logs config to INF-5567 and request delivery to your bucket. For the Dedicated node, expect ~3-4 hour provisioning once infra verifies peering.

Priya B: Sending the spend acknowledgement to jing@nova.ai. Once signed we'll apply credits and lock the spend shield. Expect email confirmation within 1 hour of signature.

Jing (Nova): Signed and returned. Also confirm we can limit API key use to specific IP ranges?

Ari H: Yes, project-scoped API keys can be IP-restricted and scoped to routes (generation/embeddings). We'll add IP allowlist if you provide ranges.

Jing (Nova): IP ranges: 34.200.0.0/18 and 3.110.0.0/16.

InfraBot: INF-5567 updated: VPC CIDR and AWS acct added; flow logs target=arn:aws:s3:::nova-redwood-logs; retention=120d; provisioning ETA updated to 4h.

Felix (SE): I pushed a tiny sample to the shared repo (examples/nova/poc) showing how to rotate ephemeral keys and call the generation API with the model whitelist.

Jing (Nova): I can see the credits in the Console and the example repo. Thanks all! We'll run initial smoke tests today and post any issues. :rocket:

Ari H: Great. Closing loop: Priya will confirm billing actions done; InfraBot/Raj will update provisioning; Felix will support integration. Reopen this thread if anything blocks.

Priya B: Credits applied and spend shield active. Email confirmation sent to jing@nova.ai.

Jing (Nova): Verified charges blocked at cap and alerts are routing to our #nova-poc Slack. All green on our side.

Felix (SE): Ping me if you need TTL >72h for CI keys; we can set a service key with stricter IP rules.

Jing (Nova): Will do, thanks!
